narrative.gap_prioritization_md: Categories are ranked using the 6-factor priority framework: Business Impact (25%), Risk Exposure (20%), Competitive Gap (20%), Effort Inverse (15%), Quick Win Potential (10%), and Trend Alignment (10%). Each factor is scored 1-5, producing a composite priority score.
narrative.recommendations_md: Ten evidence-grounded recommendations map to 10 of 12 Zennify solutions, organized by priority. Each recommendation follows the Root Cause (evidence) + Solution (Zennify offering) + Expected Outcomes structure. No investment amounts, cost estimates, or timelines are included per assessment protocol.
narrative.roadmap_md: The transformation roadmap sequences 10 recommendations into three waves based on dependencies, effort, and strategic foundation requirements. No timelines are specified per assessment protocol.
